unsupported-input.description: Return no name for an explicitly invalid development input.

graph-identity.description: Preserve graph, charge, isotope and specified stereochemistry.

principal-alcohol-suffix.description: Represent principal OH groups with an alcohol suffix.

ordinary-ester-class.description: Keep the ordinary ester as the functional class rather than an oxycarbonyl substituent.

lactone-suffix-parent.description: Keep the reviewed lactone carbonyl on its preferred heterocyclic parent.

functional-parent-indicated-H.description: Keep the H-state accommodating the lactone suffix.

iodanium-terminology.description: Use the preferred systematic iodine cation stem.

longest-alkanyl-ligand.description: Retain the internal attachment position on the unbranched carbon chain, as an alkanyl ligand or an alkanamine parent in functional-class amine oxide nomenclature. The separate graph obligation remains required.

polycycle-prefix-join.description: Do not add a prefix-parent separator before the generic polycycle descriptor.

compact-simple-methyl.description: Preserve the reviewed simple dimethyl construction.

carbonyl-H-double-count.description: Added indicated hydrogen and hydro prefixes must refer to disjoint positions on the reviewed fused parent. Added H is permitted when the suffix needs it.

carbonyl-suffix.description: Keep the reviewed cyclic carbonyl as an one suffix.

complete-ligand-order.description: Alphabetize the complete reviewed iodine ligands, ignoring their locants.

hypervalent-iodine-lambda.description: Make the nonstandard iodine valence explicit in reviewed 0179.

simple-ligand-multiplication.description: Use di rather than bis for the reviewed simple repeated phenyl/ethyl groups.

steroid-preferred-parent.description: Resolve preferred fused parent selection for these reviewed steroid graphs.

preferred-tetrahydronaphthalenyl.description: Resolve the reviewed general tetralin prefix.

preferred-ethynyl.description: Use the preferred ethynyl rather than acetenyl component.

preferred-prenyl-component.description: Resolve the general prenyl component into its preferred construction.

complete-spiro-carbonyl-suffix.description: Cite principal ketone/lactone carbonyls as suffixes only after complete spiro assembly.

principal-acid-class.description: Cite the senior neutral acid as the principal function.

principal-carbamate-class.description: Cite the senior carbamate ester functional class rather than a junior amide.

principal-amide-class.description: Cite the ordinary amide rather than a junior hydrazide/oxygen function.

principal-hydrazide-class.description: Cite the hydrazide rather than a junior oxygen function.

principal-nitrile-class.description: Cite the nitrile rather than a junior aldehyde, ketone or alcohol.

principal-polyacid-coverage.description: Express all three principal acid sites as suffixes.

principal-polyester-coverage.description: Express the three ordinary ester sites as one functional class.

principal-polyamide-coverage.description: Express all three primary amide sites as suffixes.

principal-polynitrile-coverage.description: Express all three nitrile sites as suffixes.

retained-oxalic-functional-root.description: Preserve the preferred retained oxalic acid / oxalate root.

retained-oxamide-functional-root.description: Preserve the preferred retained oxamide root.

numbered-fused-steroid-parent.description: Use a numbered fused hydride and explicit full hydrogenation state for the reviewed unspecified-stereo steroid skeleton.

complete-fused-functional-suffix.description: Express the independently selected fused carbonyl groups using a carbonyl suffix; local suffix property only.

dyphylline-annular-H.description: The reviewed selected hydrogen-state construction must not introduce an H state at unprotonated annular N9.

complete-polyamide-suffix.description: All ordinary carboxamide sites appear in a complete amide suffix.

complete-polyester-suffix.description: Repeated ester groups appear in a complete functional-class ester name.

preferred-alkyl-vocabulary.description: Use preferred systematic alkyl components and the complete retained tert spelling; no whole-name PIN claim.

complete-carbamate-parent.description: Preferred component spellings must not displace a supported carbamate parent.

complete-phosphorodiamidite-parent.description: Retain functional-parent selection when preferred N-ligand spelling needs complex multipliers.

class16-N-ring-seniority.description: Among equally covered class-16 ring carbonyl systems, a unique N heterocycle precedes O/C systems before ring size.

component-indicated-H.description: Preserve the indicated-H state of the lactone component as a parent or prefix.
